name: Domyn Edge (Base, SFT, Teacher checkpoints)

lineage.how_derived: SFT checkpoint = one broad pass over math, code, tool calling and instruction following; no RL or preference optimisation; rolling release in three bundles, with per-domain Teacher checkpoints (IF, Math, Code, Agentic) (card)

purpose: Fully open small model line with long context, agentic and tool-calling use in 12 languages; the SFT checkpoint is a clean starting point for fine-tuning (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (card tag; 'fully open')
license.notes: Card tag only; no LICENSE file opened.

architecture.kind: dense transformer (DomynEdgeForCausalLM, custom code), hidden 2560, intermediate 9728, context 262,144; about 4B from the 7.87 GB BF16 repo size (my arithmetic)

variants.notes: repo total per HF API; Base 2.3k downloads, SFT 1.5k

pc-12gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (9.6 GB)

pc-16gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (13.6 GB)

pc-24gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (21.6 GB)

pc-32gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (29.6 GB)

mac-16-24gb.notes: 7.9 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 7.9 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 7.9 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

strengths: European (Italian) fully open release with German among 12 languages
weaknesses: SFT checkpoint without RL: card warns of weaker single-attempt robustness
release incomplete (further checkpoints still to come)

tona_fit.reason: A 4B-class fully open model with long context and tool calling; wait for the final post-trained checkpoint and numbers before judging against Qwen3.5/Gemma-4 small models.

open_questions: Parameter count not stated in the part read
